You're not going in circles for nothing — the loop is the whole thing. Unseen means uncounted, and unseen also means ungraded. Both are true at once, and no amount of thinking resolves it.

The only thing that breaks a loop like that is one instance of it. One Wednesday, twenty minutes of lunch spent with the book open, nobody told. Not to prove it counts — just to find out what it actually feels like when no one's grading and no one's holding it up.
